SELECT t1.code_module, t1.id_assessment
FROM (
  SELECT a.code_module, sa.id_assessment, AVG(sa.score) AS avg_score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.code_module ORDER BY AVG(sa.score) DESC) as rn
  FROM studentAssessment sa
  JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment
  GROUP BY a.code_module, sa.id_assessment
) t1
WHERE t1.rn = 1
